nodes.label: Manna Mark (source vector)
nodes.rationale: The brand mark is the single source-of-truth vector for all Manna app icons: a 280x280 viewBox containing three stroked, open arcs drawn concentrically and uniformly scaled (1.6512) about the canvas centre. Nothing is filled; the logo is pure stroke with round line caps, so it stays legible at 32px and reads as a hand-drawn gesture rather than a corporate glyph. Because every raster icon is a render of this one file, colour or geometry changes propagate by re-exporting rather than by editing four assets.

nodes.label: Nested Open-Arcs Motif
nodes.rationale: Three concentric arcs of decreasing radius (75.75, 34.74, 18.95) each deliberately left open with a gap, reading inward from a near-complete outer ring to a small dark smile/bowl at the centre. The gaps mean no ring ever closes, giving a containment-and-provision reading (an open vessel, a portion set aside) that suits a stewardship log rather than a sealed 'balance' or 'total' symbol. The inward-shrinking repetition also mirrors the app's own two-level containment structure: an outer whole holding a smaller inner part.

nodes.label: Earth-Tone Brand Palette
nodes.rationale: Three muted earth strokes ordered by depth: sage/olive #9F9A77 on the outer ring, clay/tan #A2886E in the middle, dark walnut #5E4634 at the core, over a warm beige field. Value darkens as radius shrinks, so the eye is pulled to the centre without any accent or saturated colour. The palette is intentionally non-fintech: no green-for-gain, no red-for-loss, no blue trust-badge, which keeps the app from reading as a budgeting or banking tool and matches its framing as a personal log rather than a ledger of performance.

nodes.label: Stroke-Only, Round-Cap Construction
nodes.rationale: Every path uses fill="none" with a near-uniform stroke-width (7.9 / 7.4 / 7.9) and stroke-linecap="round". Holding the stroke weight almost constant across three very different radii is what makes the arcs read as one family instead of three unrelated rings, and the round caps prevent the open gaps from looking like clipped or broken geometry. This same stroke-weight discipline is what lets the mark sit beside the app's line-style Remix Icon category glyphs without looking heavier than them.
